test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

The team leader said to us, "Congratulations! You have prepared a very good presentation."

options.text: The team leader said congratulations and told us that we have prepared a very good presentation.
We told our team leader that we had prepared a very good presentation and he said congratulations.
The team leader told us congratulations and we had prepared a very good presentation.
The team leader congratulated us and said that we had prepared a very good presentation.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The team leader congratulated us and said that we had prepared a very good presentation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The exclamatory sentence in the direct speech changes to an assertive sentence in the indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'congratulated' (in case of congratulation mentioned in the direct speech)
 
• "and" is added to join the clause in the indirect speech when someone is giving a command/approval to someone else.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the conjunction 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letters.
 
• The pronoun 'you' changes to 'we' to form the indirect speech part.
 
• If the direct part clause is written in the **present perfect **tense then we have to convert it into the **past perfect** tense. therefore, **"have prepared"** changes to **"had prepared"** in the indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

The indirect sentence is: *The team leader congratulated us and said that we had prepared a very good presentation.*
